neighbours.label: a short pro-form standing for a situation already described (as was the case, such as existed, such as today's, I know I would), as opposed to plain statements with the same words
fire: Roads can fail, as was the case when the flood hit the town.
In a dry period, such as existed in the 1930s, crops die.
Prices rose in earlier booms such as today's.
You'd quit in a week. I know I would.
Schools were closed, as was the case in several cities.
He may refuse, as others have.
When a bank fails, as happened in 2008, panic spreads.
Most people would complain. I certainly would.
quiet: Roads can flood, and the case went to court in the town.
In a dry year the wells in the village run out.
Prices rose in the shop on the corner today.
You'd love this week. I know a nice hotel.
Schools were closed, and the case was dropped in court.
He may refuse the cake at dinner.
When a bank opens, people bring their money.
Most people would like this one. It is warm.

short: pro-form for a situation already described
